description.p: ZeroSpades is a fork of OpenSpades, a clone of Ace of Spades 0.75, which is a free online first-person shooter created by Ben Aksoy, featuring fully destructible terrain and plenty of game modes (including the well-known Capture the Flag) created by the community.

ul.li: Can connect to a vanilla/pyspades/pysnip server
Uses OpenGL/AL for better experience
Open source, and cross platform
Added mod manager: download, enable/disable and apply official mods directly from the Mods tab in the main screen.
Added demo recording/replaying (Check its Wiki page!). (#13)
Added pie menu for quick communication thought chat messages. (#15)
Added circular and rotating mode for the minimap (currently only available for OpenGL renderer).
Added navigation bar in Preferences window, displaying buttons for each heading in the active tab. (#30)
Remember selected tab and scroll position in in-game settings (#36).
Added Compatible Mods button linking to zerospades-paks repository.
Added viewmodel position presets (Default, Balanced, Minimal).
Added warning alert when taking water damage.
Added support for MessageTypes extension.
Added application architecture in client version response.
Added riscv64 support (#28).
Improved Windows version detection (should correctly detect Windows 10/11 now).
Improved left-handed view by correctly mirroring models and animations.
Fixed flatpak packages (#51).
Fixed a bug that prevented the landing sound from playing when taking fall damage.
Fixed a bug in the PlayerProperties extension that caused an incorrect player score. (#35).
Fixed wrong message color code value (#40).
Fixed a bug that prevented players from placing blocks under them when jumping (#47).
Fixed an issue with shadows being rendered through walls when SSAO was enabled (yvt/openspades#862).
Fixed shotgun spam and highlight critical hits for damage numbers.
Ragdoll removal limits now configurable via cg_corpseSoftLimit and cg_corpseHardLimit.
Prevent multiline/newlines on text fields, player names and chat messages.
AngelScript has been updated from v2.31.1 to v2.38.0.
OpenAL has been updated to OpenAL-soft.
YSR audio backend has been removed due to lack of use and it no longer being maintained.

description.p: Additionally, users playing in non-Latin languages (such as Russian, Chinese, Greek, Arabic, etc.) are encouraged to download NotoFonts.pak. It contains beautifully designed Roboto and Noto Fonts, which cover all languages supported by ZeroSpades. It can be installed via the Mods tab in the main screen, or manually by copying it to the Resource directory.

ul.li: Configurable keybindings for quick volume control (cg_keyVolumeUp, cg_keyVolumeDown).
Toggle spectator mode at any time for admins (cg_keyStaffSpectating).
Added weapon charms/keychains (cg_weaponCharms).
Added cartoon-style outlines in OpenGL mode (r_outlines).
Option to display the names of dead players (cg_playerNamesDead).
Added an option to switch between classic recoil and the v0.1.3 recoil model (cg_classicWeaponRecoil).
